items.title: 1.10 Oxides aur chlorides mein oxidation number ki tabdeeli (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.10, printed page 18, with Quick Check 1.9 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Kisi atom ka oxidation number us atom par molecule ya ion mein formal (hisaabi) charge hai. Oxidation number ko oxidation state bhi kehte hain. Ionic compounds mein atom ka oxidation number woh charge hai jo us ke ion par nazar aata hai.
Ab period 3 ke oxides aur chlorides mein oxidation numbers dekhte hain.

Period 3 ke element ka us ke oxide ya chloride mein oxidation number un electrons ki tadaad ke barabar hai jo bonding mein istemal hote hain, aur yeh hamesha positive hota hai, kyun ke oxygen aur chlorine in sab elements se zyada electronegative hain. Oxidation number group number ke barabar hota hai, jo valence electrons ki kul tadaad hai. Table 1.2 dekhein. Oxides mein oxidation number Na ke +1 se S ke +6 tak barhta hai. Chlorides mein Na ke +1 se P ke +5 tak. Phosphorus aur sulfur ke kai oxidation numbers hain, kyun ke yeh electrons ko khali 3d orbitals mein bhej (excite kar) ke apna octet bara kar sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Table 1.2: Period 3 ke oxides aur chlorides mein oxidation numbers
rows: P₄O₁₀ mein P / P₄O₆ mein P

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Table 1.2 mein SCl₂ mein sulfur ka oxidation number -2 chhapa hai. Sahi +2 hai: har chlorine -1 hai, do chlorine mil kar -2, is liye neutral molecule mein sulfur +2 hoga. Period 3 ke chlorides mein oxidation number hamesha positive hota hai.
Maslan SO₂ mein sulfur ka oxidation number +4 hai kyun ke bonding mein sirf chaar electrons istemal hote hain, jab ke SO₃ mein +6 hai kyun ke chhe ke chhe electrons bonding mein lagte hain.

blocks.prompt: a) SO₂ aur SO₃ mein sulfur ka oxidation number nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Har oxygen −2 hai aur molecule neutral hai. SO₂: x + 2(−2) = 0, is liye x = +4. SO₃: x + 3(−2) = 0, is liye x = +6.

blocks.prompt: b) Kuch p-block elements variable (badalte) oxidation states kyun dikhate hain?
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus aur sulfur jaise period 3 ke elements ke paas khali 3d orbitals hain. Yeh apne electrons ko 3d orbitals mein excite kar ke bonding ke liye zyada ya kam valence electrons istemal kar sakte hain, is liye phosphorus +3 ya +5 aur sulfur +4 ya +6 dikhata hai.

items: Oxidation number molecule ya ion mein atom par formal charge hai; period 3 ke oxides aur chlorides mein yeh positive aur group number ke barabar hai: oxides mein +1 (Na) se +6 (S), chlorides mein +1 se +5 (P).
P aur S 3d orbitals ki madad se kai oxidation numbers dikhate hain: SO₂ mein +4, SO₃ mein +6.
